selection.discovery_control: fixed seed 42, matching original NLA selection
selection.discovery_gate: lift >= .20 vs unsteered and seed-42 random; coverage >= .50; both 2000-resample one-sided lower bounds > 0, BEFORE quality ranking
selection.rank: descending mean maximum prompt-matched content-word Jaccard; stable discovery rank for ties

calibration_rule: maximize hit rate among quality-eligible alphas; ties choose lower alpha; fallback .5
generation_seed_formula: 42 + concept_id * 10000 + absolute_prompt_index * 10; reset before each arm/alpha batch of two samples

injection.diffmean: all prompt and generated positions; archived fixed-panel inject()
injection.nla: last prompt and each generated token; archived steering.generate()

historical_generation_rng: not seeded or saved; source guide explicitly documents stochastic text generation
confirmation_injection: Original NLA selection convention: unit residual-norm direction at final prompt token and each decoded token; unsteered batch generation unchanged
exactness_limitations: Archived first pass retained at DiffMean alpha .3 and existing three controls; original NLA first pass alpha .5 and one control; no 500-concept generation rerun
Historical generation RNG not recorded; paired deterministic seeds are newly frozen
Final baseline calibration/evaluation retain archived method-specific injection conventions
Previously generated held-out responses may be reused only after panel freeze, without altering selection/tuning rules
